What's your return and refund policy?
Here is a quick overview of how our returns and refunds work:
Standard returns (UK): Returns are free within the UK. If you return an item within 30 days of receipt in its original condition, we will refund the amount you paid for it.
Sale items: You have 14 days to notify us of the return by registering it with our online returns partner ZigZag, then a further 14 days to send it back in its original condition.
Exchanges: We do not offer exchanges. Please return the item for a refund and place a new order online so you can see up‑to‑date stock and delivery information.
Non‑refundable items: Swimwear if the hygiene strip has been removed, and earrings if the internal packaging seal has been broken.
Orders with a pre‑order outstanding: If you return an item from an order that still has a pre‑order item to come, the cost of the outstanding item may be deducted from your refund, with the remaining balance returned to your original payment method.
365‑day quality guarantee: After the standard return period (or 14 days for sale items), you can return anything that does not meet our quality standards up to one year after your order arrived, for account credit. For faulty items, if you return within 6 months of receipt we will refund your item; between 6 and 12 months we will credit your Boden account for the amount paid. Account credit has no expiry and can be used on any future order, including sale items. If you purchased with a discount or offer, we will adjust the refund accordingly.
